Works out a copy of each trade a followed trader made: how much to buy, or how much of your copy to sell, and at what price.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.copySize` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `skipped` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Buy size (`sizing`) | text | no | `fixed` | fixed: Dollars a buy. multiple: Multiple times what they spent. proportional: the share of their portfolio they spent, of what the workflow's paper account is worth. One of `fixed`, `multiple`, `proportional`. |
| Dollars (`dollars`) | number | no | `10` | A fixed buy's dollars. |
| Multiple (`multiple`) | number | no | `0.1` | For multiple: 0.1 buys a tenth of what they spent. |
| Slippage (`slippage`) | number | no | `0.02` | How much worse than their price per share a copy may pay, or take when it sells. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `copy` | object; not always there | The order that copies the trade, for Place order. |
| `copy.side` | text, one of `buy`, `sell` | buy or sell. |
| `copy.tokenId` | text | The outcome's token ID. |
| `copy.marketId` | text | The market's condition ID. |
| `copy.price` | decimal | The limit: their price, worse by at most Slippage, on the market's tick. |
| `copy.dollars` | decimal; or null | A buy's dollars; null for a sell. |
| `copy.shares` | decimal; or null | A sell's shares; null for a buy. |
| `copy.type` | text, one of `FAK` | FAK: what the book has within the price, at once. |
| `skipped` | object; not always there | Out of skipped: why there is no copy. |
| `skipped.reason` | text | Why, like nothing held to sell. |
